features: 5W Powerful Sound Output: Experience clear, loud, and balanced audio with 5W output—perfect for music, podcasts, audiobooks, and calls without messy wires.
Up to 32 Hours Playtime: Enjoy nonstop music for up to 32 hours on a single charge, ideal for small parties, travel, and indoor use.

TWS & Twin Pairing Support: Pair two HAMMER Drop X1 speakers together effortlessly for a richer, immersive stereo sound experience. Built-in Microphone: Take clear hands-free calls directly through the speaker without reaching for your phone.

Multiple Playback Options: Supports Bluetooth, TF/microSD card, and USB input for flexible, device-free music playback. Type-C Fast Charging: Recharge quickly and efficiently with the modern Type-C charging port for reliable power delivery.
Auto-Pairing Bluetooth Connectivity: Automatically reconnects to the last paired device for quick, hassle-free use every time.
description: The Hammer Drop X1 5W Bluetooth Wireless Speaker is a versatile and powerful audio device designed to enhance your listening experience with a range of advanced features. Its 5-watt output ensures clear and dynamic sound, making it ideal for various audio needs, from music playback to podcasts and audiobooks.The Bluetooth speaker is equipped with a 1200 mAh battery, offering long-lasting performance and up to 100 hours of standby time.One of the standout features of the Hammer Drop X1 speaker is its True Wireless Stereo (TWS) function, which allows you to pair two speakers for an immersive stereo sound experience. Additionally, the built-in FM radio and support for TF cards and USB drives provide multiple playback options, catering to diverse listening preferences.
